To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the most effective retrieval systems use a simple statistical technique (tf-idf) that is based on the frequencies of individual words in the documents, and the most effective retrieval methods use a combination of statistical and linguistic information.

(i) a simple statistical technique (tf*idf) performs well in information retrieval; (ii) the use of full text search is more effective than using only titles and abstracts; and (iii) the use of natural language processing techniques in full text search is a promising approach to information retrieval.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of information retrieval (IR) systems.
the use of natural language processing to support the retrieval of information from large collections of text.
developing techniques for information retrieval that are based on a thorough understanding of the nature of language and of the way in which people use language to communicate.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NLP is an important tool for IR.
NLP is a promising technology for information retrieval.
the use of natural language processing techniques in information retrieval has been limited and that the opportunities for using them in this area are still largely unexplored.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new and efficient method of information retrieval that is based on natural language processing and is applicable to the retrieval of documents, data and knowledge.

we have developed a system for full text retrieval, which has the following characteristics: 1) it uses natural language processing techniques, 2) it is based on a statistical approach, and 3) it has been rigorously evaluated.
we have developed a system that allows users to search full text, with a high recall and precision, in an efficient manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the best way to improve retrieval is to improve the quality and diversity of the data on which the retrieval system operates.
the best way to improve retrieval effectiveness in the future may be to focus on improving the user interface.
the use of natural language techniques in information retrieval is a promising area for further research.
